#### Checklist

- [ ] only relevant code is changed (no version bump, changelog or build output; we do those at release)
- [ ] tests are included, and they fail without the change
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] written with an AI agent? Fine: say so, and I have read the diff and run the tests myself
- [ ] commit message and code follow the [Developer's Certificate of Origin](https://github.com/i18next/.github/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#developers-certificate-of-origin)
